Store 'N' Bolt — GTA 6 guide

Confirmed by multiple launch guides · not personally verified Northern Ambrosia

Storage up by the big monument at the north end of Ambrosia.

Full guide — contains spoilers

Store 'N' Bolt costs $16,800 and is located in northern Ambrosia, northwest of the Wyatt Motors garage, right near the large monument in the northern part of town. It is purchased through the Vice City Real Estate app once garages unlock after Daily Driver in Chapter 2.

Source & evidence

Source: Can you buy houses in GTA 6? Property, garages and safehouses explained — Video Games Chronicle (2026-11-24).

Evidence: Property and garage explainer with the full eight-garage price list, read in full. Price confirmed identical in four post-launch garage lists: VGC, GTABase, gta.guide and GTABites.
